author: mark
text:
CI: bump actions/checkout to v6, actions/cache to v5

Both actions/checkout@v4 and actions/cache@v4 were on Node 20,
which GitHub deprecated via workflow run annotations and will
force to Node 24 starting 2026-06-02. v5.0.0 of each action was
the Node 24 cutover; bumping to the latest moving major tags
(checkout@v6, cache@v5) clears the deprecation. No source change.
